name: Suwa Kouki
source:
An attorney at Suwa Law Office. Although Kouki is a talented man, he has a habit of slacking off from work, and is often seen spending his time in the internet cafe "Cybaria". Suwa Kouki is an old friend of [url=/c123788]Narumi Seiji[/url], [url=/c123785]Kyouka[/url]'s father who had gone missing.

[Translated from [url=http://www2.tokai.or.jp/yayoi/m_parts/mp_char/mp_char.htm]this website[/url].]
